data: Which model shows the best performance after performing corrections from He et al. (2017) on the CoNLL-2005 dataset?

The caption states that the figure shows the performance of CoNLL-2005 models after performing corrections from He et al. (2017). The question asks which model shows the best performance after these corrections. From the analysis of the graph, the 'Gold' line appears to be the highest among all the lines, indicating the best performance. Therefore, the 'Gold' model shows the best performance after performing corrections from He et al. (2017) on the CoNLL-2005 dataset.
